entries.title: Demo Kit ready to plan.
entries.notes: Use an installed local/testing App and an administrator with extension-management permission. The route is relative to the runner admin base (normally /admin/demo-kit). Prepare each entry independently; do not depend on capture order or colour scheme. No generation-run rows and no provenance-owned sites. Verify the recommended starting action and empty durable status.
entries.useCase: Choose a generation profile before writing any demo content.

entries.title: Recommended generation profile.
entries.notes: Use an installed local/testing App and an administrator with extension-management permission. The route is relative to the runner admin base (normally /admin/demo-kit). Prepare each entry independently; do not depend on capture order or colour scheme. No active run. The recommended profile is selected and custom controls are hidden. Close the modal without submitting after capture.
entries.useCase: Review the recommended deterministic profile.

entries.useCase: Choose custom site and language inputs.

entries.title: Generation review before confirmation.

Prepare each entry independently; do not depend on capture order or colour scheme. No active run or ordinary-name collision. Inspect site, language, page and media counts and the fingerprint. Planning must not dispatch a generation job.
entries.useCase: Check the plan before queueing it.

entries.title: Review of reusable generated sites.
entries.notes: Use an installed local/testing App and an administrator with extension-management permission. The route is relative to the runner admin base (normally /admin/demo-kit). Prepare each entry independently; do not depend on capture order or colour scheme. Prepare a site whose name matches the recommended plan and mark it through MarkDemoSiteProvenanceAction. No active run. Do not queue generation.
entries.useCase: Identify existing Demo Kit content that can be reused.

entries.title: Review blocked by ordinary content.
entries.notes: Use an installed local/testing App and an administrator with extension-management permission. The route is relative to the runner admin base (normally /admin/demo-kit). Prepare each entry independently; do not depend on capture order or colour scheme. Prepare an ordinary site with a name matching the recommended plan, without Demo Kit provenance. No active run. Do not submit the queue confirmation.
entries.useCase: See why an existing ordinary site prevents generation.

entries.title: Explicit generation confirmation.
entries.notes: Use an installed local/testing App and an administrator with extension-management permission. The route is relative to the runner admin base (normally /admin/demo-kit). Prepare each entry independently; do not depend on capture order or colour scheme. No active run or blocking collision. Verify counts and fingerprint in the confirmation. Cancel after capture; this entry must not submit the queue action.
entries.useCase: Confirm exactly the reviewed generation request.

entries.title: Explicit generation confirmation on mobile.
entries.notes: Use an installed local/testing App and an administrator with extension-management permission. The route is relative to the runner admin base (normally /admin/demo-kit). entries.title: Queued generation.
entries.notes: Use an installed local/testing App and an administrator with extension-management permission. The route is relative to the runner admin base (normally /admin/demo-kit). Prepare each entry independently; do not depend on capture order or colour scheme. Prepare the latest durable generation run with status queued, its review and fingerprint. Pause this fixture queue worker so capture cannot race execution. Confirm planning is disabled and status refresh is active.
entries.useCase: See that a confirmed request is waiting for its worker.

entries.useCase: See that a confirmed request is waiting for its worker.

entries.title: Running generation.
entries.notes: Use an installed local/testing App and an administrator with extension-management permission. The route is relative to the runner admin base (normally /admin/demo-kit). Prepare each entry independently; do not depend on capture order or colour scheme. Prepare the latest durable run with status running, review, fingerprint and started_at. Keep the fixture worker paused. Confirm planning is disabled and status refresh is active.
entries.useCase: Track generation in progress.

entries.title: Completed generation and created content.
entries.notes: Use an installed local/testing App and an administrator with extension-management permission. The route is relative to the runner admin base (normally /admin/demo-kit). Prepare each entry independently; do not depend on capture order or colour scheme. Prepare a completed latest run with review, fingerprint and real created-content links to provenance-owned fixture sites. Verify the success state and links. Do not fabricate links to absent content.
entries.useCase: Open generated sites and identify the completed plan.

entries.title: Failed generation with redacted error.
entries.notes: Use an installed local/testing App and an administrator with extension-management permission. The route is relative to the runner admin base (normally /admin/demo-kit). Prepare each entry independently; do not depend on capture order or colour scheme. Prepare a failed latest run with review, fingerprint and an error produced by RedactDemoKitErrorMessageAction. Verify the error contains no secret fixture value and planning is available.
entries.useCase: Understand a generation failure and start a fresh review.

entries.title: Provenance-only reset confirmation.
entries.notes: Use an installed local/testing App and an administrator with extension-management permission. The route is relative to the runner admin base (normally /admin/demo-kit). Prepare each entry independently; do not depend on capture order or colour scheme. Prepare one provenance-owned site and one ordinary site. Inspect the selector: only the provenance-owned site is offered. Cancel after capture; never submit a destructive reset during a screenshot capture.
entries.useCase: Select only generated sites for an explicitly confirmed reset.

Inspect the selector: only the provenance-owned site is offered. Cancel after capture; never submit a destructive reset during a screenshot capture.

entries.title: Ordinary content preserved after reset.

In an isolated fixture App, reset the provenance-owned fixture site through ResetDemoKitProvenanceAction before capture. Retain an ordinary site and no active run. Verify the reset action is absent; confirm ordinary-site survival separately through a behaviour test.
entries.useCase: Return to the planner after generated content is removed.

entries.title: Insights consent priming capture.
entries.notes: Runner-only warm-up capture that dismisses the Insights consent banner before marketplace-facing public screenshots are taken.
entries.useCase: The screenshot runner sets anonymous visitor consent state so public Demo Kit captures do not include analytics consent chrome.

entries.title: Generated demo page content widget.
entries.notes: Requires Demo Kit generated page data with a layout widget using the demo-page-content renderable. Public output should show package Blade presentation, not stored Tailwind markup from database content.
entries.useCase: A maintainer verifies generated demo pages render designed content through the package-owned Blade view.

entries.title: Generated homepage section widget.
entries.notes: Requires a generated homepage layout that includes a homepage-section renderable such as the command-centre hero widget.
entries.useCase: A maintainer checks the generated homepage uses portable CMS data with presentation kept in package Blade.
